statements.t: Drones segment backlog represents unfilled orders for which we have purchase orders, definitive agreements, or high probability of conversion with customers, as well as orders for which NATO countries have allocated funds but for which no definitive agreement has been executed but is expected once through the administrative process, in each case against for which we expect to perform and recognize the majority of…
We are a technologically differentiated aerospace, autonomy, and air mobility platform targeting 21 st century aerospace and defense opportunities.
We plan to pursue certification of our aircraft under existing CAR 529 Transport Category Rotorcraft standards.
Upon certification, we expect our cargo-configured aircraft to serve as the initial foundation of our commercialization efforts.
Our financial condition and results of operations have been, and will continue to be, affected by a number of factors, including the following.

We believe that our operating results for the foreseeable future will continue to depend to a significant extent on sales attributable to certain end customers with such concentration primarily attributable to our Drones segment.
While we believe the global market for electric air mobility will be large, it remains undeveloped and future demand is uncertain.
We anticipate receiving certification of our 33% downscaled cargo eVTOL under drone rules as early as 2027.
Our presentation of these non-GAAP financial measures should not be construed to imply that our future results will be unaffected by items that are excluded from these metrics.
